title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract: Payoff Quotes, Overpayment Refunds and Care Cancellation Credits
content:
**Payoff desk rule, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

1. A payoff quote can be issued only while the contract status is active, repossession assigned, repossessed or deficiency.
2. The good-through date is the product's quote validity period in calendar days after the quote date unless the requester asks for an earlier date.
3. The per diem is the principal balance times the contract APR divided by the product's day basis, rounded to the cent (the APR being a percentage, it enters as the APR divided by 100), and the payoff amount is the principal balance plus the fees-due balance plus the per diem times the quote interest days — the calendar days from the day after the date interest is paid to through the good-through date, both inclusive.
4. Funds received on or before the good-through date in at least the quoted amount pay the contract in full; funds received later are applied as a payment and a new quote is needed.
5. A quote for a refinance lender, dealer trade-in or insurance total-loss purpose is issued to that third party only with the customer's verified authorization on the call.
6. An overpayment refund can be issued only when the contract status is paid in full or closed.
7. A credit balance of at least the product's automatic refund threshold left after the balance reaches zero is refunded to the payer by check within the product's refund period in calendar days; a smaller credit balance is refunded only on request.
8. A cancellation refund from a financed Kestrel Care contract is credited to the principal balance and does not advance the next due date; when the contract is already paid in full or closed the refund is paid to the customer as an overpayment refund instead.

## Hypothetical payoff worked through

Principal balance 10,000.00 dollars, contract APR 7.30 percent, day basis 365, fees-due balance 25.00 dollars, interest paid to the 3rd of a month, good-through date the 13th of the same month. The per diem is 10,000.00 times 7.30 divided by 100 and by 365, which is 2.00 dollars; the quote interest days run from the 4th through the 13th, both inclusive, which is 10 days. The payoff amount is 10,000.00 plus 25.00 plus 2.00 times 10, a total of 10,045.00 dollars.

## Funds against the quote

| Funds received | Amount | Result |
|---|---|---|
| On or before the good-through date | at least the quoted amount | contract paid in full |
| After the good-through date | any | applied as a payment; a new quote is needed |
